title: PF claim reject ho gaya? Wajah aur fix.

brief.topic: PF claim reject kyun hota hai, aur kaise theek karein?
brief.viewer: Someone who left a job, filed for their PF online, and saw the claim come back rejected.
brief.hook: PF claim reject ho gaya? Paisa atka hai?
brief.problem: The claim comes back rejected and the money stays stuck, often because of a rule the member didn't know or a mismatch in their records.
why: Filed before 12 months without a job: the rule since the EPF Scheme 2026
The name or date of birth doesn't match Aadhaar
The date of exit isn't in EPFO's records
steps: Read the reason in the claim status
Correct the name or date of birth under Manage, then Modify Basic Details (no document if the UAN is Aadhaar-verified)
Mark the date of exit, 60 days after leaving
File Form 19 again once 12 months are done
brief.check: Before filing again: 12 months done, details matching Aadhaar, date of exit marked.
brief.help: If a complete claim isn't settled in 20 days, file a grievance on EPFiGMS. EPFO's services are free.
brief.share_target: A friend whose PF is stuck
brief.why_now: Evergreen: the first thing people ask after a job change, and the pilot of the channel.

data.label: EPFO says why a claim came back
data.statement: EPFO tells members why a claim came back, in remarks written for them: 'return' for an incomplete claim, 'rejection' for one the member isn't eligible for.
data.source: PIB, Ministry of Labour and Employment, 14 June 2024: EPFO rationalised claim remarks
data.check_note: Quote: 'reduced and rationalised the remarks for easy comprehension of the members for return of incomplete cases and rejection of ineligible cases.' Also open a claim's status on the member portal and confirm the remark shows there.
data.check_result: Checked against the new CITES portal and its source, 13 Nov 2026

data.label: A claim filed too early is rejected
data.statement: A claim the member isn't eligible for yet is rejected; the member portal now checks eligibility before a claim is filed.
data.source: PIB, Ministry of Labour and Employment, 17 March 2025: upfront validations on claims
data.check_note: Quote: 'upfront validations have been developed to guide members about eligibility /admissibility of claims so as to ensure that members do not file ineligible claims'. PIB 2025221 (14 June 2024) separates return of incomplete cases from rejection of ineligible ones.
data.check_result: Checked against the new CITES portal and its source, 13 Nov 2026

data.label: Months without a job before the whole PF can be withdrawn
data.source: EPF Scheme, 2026, paragraph 49(2), first proviso (Gazette of India, G.S.R. 525(E), 29 June 2026)
data.check_note: Gazette pp. 90–91: a member isn't eligible 'unless the member has not been employed ... for a continuous period of not less than twelve months immediately preceding the date of application'. The old 1952 Scheme said 2 months. Exceptions in para 49(1) and the second proviso (marriage) don't change the reel's case.
data.check_result: Checked against the new CITES portal and its source, 13 Nov 2026

data.label: Mismatched details get claims rejected
data.statement: A mismatch in date of birth, date of exit, Aadhaar or bank details is one of the usual reasons EPFO gives for rejecting a claim.
data.source: Lok Sabha, Unstarred Question 2680, answered 9 March 2026 (reasons for rejection of claims)
data.check_note: The link reproduces the official reply (it lists mismatches in date of birth, exit date, service details, Aadhaar or bank details). Find the reply on sansad.in, check it says this, and put that official link here instead. The reply is about pension claims; confirm it applies to PF claims too, or say so.
data.check_result: Checked against the new CITES portal and its source, 13 Nov 2026

data.label: Who puts the date of exit in
data.statement: The employer must upload who left within fifteen days of each month's end; the member can also record their own date of exit.
data.source: EPF Scheme, 2026, paragraph 24(2)(v) (G.S.R. 525(E)); PIB, 8 January 2021 (members record their date of exit)
data.check_note: Para 24(2)(v): 'Every employer shall, within fifteen days of the close of each month, upload ... details of the employees leaving the service'. For the member's own entry: PIB https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1687113 ('record their date of exit themselves').
data.check_result: Checked against the new CITES portal and its source, 13 Nov 2026

data.label: Members log in to the member portal with their UAN
data.statement: Members log in to the EPFO member portal with their UAN and password.
data.check_note: Open the page: the login box asks for the UAN and the password. (UAN activation has moved to the UMANG app; logging in hasn't.)
data.check_result: Checked against the new CITES portal and its source, 13 Nov 2026

data.label: Where a wrong name or date of birth is corrected
data.statement: On the member portal, a wrong name or date of birth is corrected under Manage, then Modify Basic Details.
data.source: PIB, Ministry of Labour and Employment, 19 January 2025: members correct their own profile
data.check_note: PIB describes the facility; the menu name Manage → Modify Basic Details comes from news reports only. Log in to the member portal and confirm the menu is still called that after the July 2026 upgrade.
data.check_result: Checked against the new CITES portal and its source, 13 Nov 2026

data.label: Aadhaar-verified UANs need no document to correct details
data.statement: A member whose UAN is verified with Aadhaar can correct their name, date of birth and other details themselves, without uploading any document (some UANs issued before 1 October 2017 also need the employer's certification).
data.source: PIB, Ministry of Labour and Employment, 19 January 2025: members correct their own profile
data.check_note: Quote: 'members whose Universal Account Number (UAN) has already been validated through Aadhaar can update their profile like name, date of birth ... themselves without the requirement of uploading any document. Only, in certain cases where UAN was obtained prior to 1-10-2017, the updation would require certification of employer only.'
data.check_result: Checked against the new CITES portal and its source, 13 Nov 2026

data.label: Days after leaving before the member can mark their own date of exit
data.check_note: Find: 'After 60 days from the date of leaving of services, the member can him self submit / update Date of Exit online through Member Portal.' The research couldn't open the page (seen in a search snippet only), and the menu (Manage → Mark Exit) may have changed after the July 2026 upgrade: confirm both on the portal.
data.check_result: Checked against the new CITES portal and its source, 13 Nov 2026

data.label: Days EPFO has to settle a complete claim
data.source: EPF Scheme, 2026, paragraph 54(7) (Gazette of India, G.S.R. 525(E), 29 June 2026)
data.check_note: Gazette p. 94: a claim complete in all respects 'shall be settled and the benefit amount paid to the beneficiaries within twenty days from the date of receipt by the Commissioner.' (It was paragraph 72(7) in the 1952 Scheme.)
data.check_result: Checked against the new CITES portal and its source, 13 Nov 2026

data.label: EPFO's grievance portal
data.statement: EPFO takes grievances online on its EPFiGMS portal, epfigms.gov.in, which is also inside the UMANG app.
data.check_note: Open it: 'Register Grievance', for PF members, pensioners and employers; the site says 'EPFiGMS is available in UMANG.'
data.check_result: Checked against the new CITES portal and its source, 13 Nov 2026

data.label: EPFO's services are free
data.statement: EPFO's services are free: members shouldn't pay any fee to agents or cyber cafes.
data.source: PIB, Ministry of Labour and Employment, 16 June 2025
data.check_note: Find: members 'should not pay any fees to third party agents or cyber cafes' for EPFO's services.
data.check_result: Checked against the new CITES portal and its source, 13 Nov 2026

script.vo: PF claim reject ho gaya? Paisa atka hai?
script.tts: पीएफ क्लेम रिजेक्ट हो गया? पैसा अटका है?

script.vo: Ghabrao mat. Pehle wajah samjho, phir aaram se theek karo.
script.tts: घबराओ मत। पहले वजह समझो, फिर आराम से ठीक करो।

script.vo: Maan lo, passbook mein aapka hissa ₹1,50,000, company ka ₹50,000.
script.tts: मान लो, पासबुक में आपका हिस्सा डेढ़ लाख रुपये, कंपनी का पचास हज़ार।

script.vo: Kul ₹2,00,000 atke, aur claim seedha wapas aa gaya.
script.tts: कुल दो लाख रुपये अटके, और क्लेम सीधा वापस आ गया।

script.vo: Wajah claim status mein likhi hoti hai. Pehle wahi dhyan se padho.
script.tts: वजह क्लेम स्टेटस में लिखी होती है। पहले वही ध्यान से पढ़ो।

script.vo: Ek: naukri chhode 12 mahine nahi hue. Do: naam ya janam tithi Aadhaar se alag. Teen: exit date daali nahi.
script.tts: एक: नौकरी छोड़े बारह महीने नहीं हुए। दो: नाम या जन्म तिथि आधार से अलग। तीन: एग्ज़िट डेट डाली नहीं।

script.vo: Ab theek karo. Member portal pe apne UAN se login karo.
script.tts: अब ठीक करो। मेंबर पोर्टल पे अपने यूएएन से लॉगिन करो।

script.vo: Naam ya janam tithi galat? Manage, phir Modify Basic Details.
script.tts: नाम या जन्म तिथि गलत? मैनेज, फिर मॉडिफ़ाई बेसिक डिटेल्स।

script.vo: UAN Aadhaar se verified hai, toh koi document nahi chahiye.
script.tts: यूएएन आधार से वेरिफ़ाइड है, तो कोई डॉक्यूमेंट नहीं चाहिए।

script.vo: Exit date nahi? 60 din baad aap khud Mark Exit kar sakte ho.
script.tts: एग्ज़िट डेट नहीं? साठ दिन बाद आप ख़ुद मार्क एग्ज़िट कर सकते हो।

script.vo: Dobara file karne se pehle check karo. 12 mahine pure, exit date marked.
script.tts: दोबारा फ़ाइल करने से पहले चेक करो। बारह महीने पूरे, एग्ज़िट डेट मार्क्ड।

script.vo: Teeno theek? Tabhi Form 19 se claim dobara bharo.
script.tts: तीनों ठीक? तभी फ़ॉर्म नाइनटीन से क्लेम दोबारा भरो।

script.vo: 20 din mein bhi na aaye? EPFiGMS pe shikayat karo.
script.tts: बीस दिन में भी ना आए? ईपीएफ़आईजीएमएस पे शिकायत करो।

script.vo: Jiska PF atka hai, us dost ko abhi yeh bhejo.
script.tts: जिसका पीएफ अटका है, उस दोस्त को अभी ये भेजो।

script.vo: PF samjho, claim pao. EPFO ki har jankari chahiye? Follow karo PF Guru Ji.
script.tts: पीएफ समझो, क्लेम पाओ। ईपीएफओ की हर जानकारी चाहिए? फ़ॉलो करो पीएफ गुरु जी।

post.caption:
PF claim reject ho gaya? Ghabrao mat.

Claim status mein wajah padho. Aam wajah: naukri chhode 12 mahine nahi hue (naya niyam), naam ya date of birth Aadhaar se alag, ya exit date nahi. Sab member portal pe theek hota hai, aur shikayat EPFiGMS pe. EPFO ki services free hain.

Yeh us dost ko bhejo jiska PF atka hai.

EPFO ki har jankari chahiye? Follow karo @pfguruji.

PF Guru Ji EPFO ka official channel nahi hai. Niyam: epfo.gov.in
